description: Create 3 partner dashboard components, 2 admin dashboard components, and 1 public page. Partner and admin components depend on FEAT-001 (career/ components). The public page (CertificateVerification) imports careerService only. Independent of FEAT-002.
steps: Create frontend/src/components/dashboard/partner/FeedbackForm.jsx. Props: applicationId, studentName, internshipTitle, onSubmit, onCancel. State: ratings({technical:0, communication:0, problemSolving:0, teamwork:0, professionalism:0, learningAbility:0}), strengths(''), areasForImprovement(''), comments(''), submitting(bool). Six star rating rows (1-5): label + 5 clickable Star icons from lucide-react, filled (text-amber-400 fill-amber-400) for selected and below, outline (text-gray-300) above. Strengths textarea, Areas for Improvement textarea, Comments textarea. Submit button: calls api.post('/internship-feedback', {applicationId, ...ratings, strengths, areasForImprovement, comments}) then onSubmit(). Cancel button calls onCancel(). Validation: all 6 ratings must be >= 1 before submit. Import { api } from '../../../services/api'. Default export. NOTE: this is a sub-component used by CompletionWorkflow, but exported as standalone.

Create frontend/src/components/dashboard/partner/CompletionWorkflow.jsx. Imports: { api } from '../../../services/api'; { getPartnerCompletions, updateCompletionStatus } from '../../../services/careerService'; FeedbackForm from './FeedbackForm'; Modal from '../../ui/Modal'; Button from '../../ui/Button'; { Skeleton } from '../../ui/Skeleton'; EmptyState from '../../ui/EmptyState'; { CheckCircle2, Award } from 'lucide-react'; { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; { toast } from 'react-hot-toast'. State: completions(array), loading(bool), confirmModal({open:false, applicationId:null, newStatus:''}), feedbackModal({open:false, applicationId:null, studentName:'', internshipTitle:''}). On mount fetch getPartnerCompletions(). Status progression badges: Selected→amber, Started→blue, In Progress→purple, Completed→green. 'Update Status' button opens confirmModal; on confirm calls updateCompletionStatus(id, {status:newStatus}) then refetches. When status becomes Completed: show 'Issue Certificate' button → opens CertificateWorkflow path (link to /partner/dashboard/certificates). 'Mark Completed' button opens feedbackModal with FeedbackForm. On feedback submit: toast.success('Feedback submitted!'). Loading: 3 Skeleton h-20. Empty: EmptyState. Default export.

Create frontend/src/components/dashboard/partner/CertificateWorkflow.jsx. Imports: { api } from '../../../services/api'; { getPartnerCompletions, issueCertificate } from '../../../services/careerService'; Button from '../../ui/Button'; { Skeleton } from '../../ui/Skeleton'; EmptyState from '../../ui/EmptyState'; { Award, CheckCircle2 } from 'lucide-react'; { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; { toast } from 'react-hot-toast'. State: completions(array), loading(bool), issuing(obj {}). On mount fetch getPartnerCompletions({status:'completed'}). Table/list columns: student name, internship title, completion date, status badge, 'Issue Certificate' button. 'Issue Certificate' button: calls issueCertificate({applicationId, studentId, internshipId}) then sets local issued status. Note displayed below header: 'Admin must verify before certificate becomes active'. Issued certificates show status badge. Loading: Skeleton. Empty: EmptyState title='No Completed Internships' message='Completed internships will appear here for certificate issuance'. Default export.

Create frontend/src/components/dashboard/admin/CertificateManagement.jsx. Imports: { api } from '../../../services/api'; { getAllCertificates, verifyCertificateAdmin, revokeCertificate } from '../../../services/careerService'; Button from '../../ui/Button'; Modal from '../../ui/Modal'; { Skeleton } from '../../ui/Skeleton'; EmptyState from '../../ui/EmptyState'; { Award, Search, Filter } from 'lucide-react'; { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; { toast } from 'react-hot-toast'. State: certificates(array), loading(bool), statusFilter('all'|'pending'|'active'|'revoked'), searchQuery(''), revokeModal({open:false, certId:null}). On mount and on filter change fetch getAllCertificates({status:statusFilter}). Search filters client-side by certificateId. Table: columns certificateId (monospace), student name, organization, role, issuedAt (formatted date), status badge (pending=amber, active=emerald, revoked=red), actions. 'Verify' button (only for pending): calls verifyCertificateAdmin(id) then toast + refetch. 'Revoke' button: opens revokeModal; on confirm calls revokeCertificate(id) then toast + refetch. Status filter dropdown. Search input with Search icon. Loading: table Skeleton. Empty: EmptyState. Default export.

Create frontend/src/components/dashboard/admin/CareerIntelligenceInsights.jsx. Imports: { api } from '../../../services/api'; { getCareerInsights } from '../../../services/careerService'; { Skeleton } from '../../ui/Skeleton'; EmptyState from '../../ui/EmptyState'; Card from '../../ui/Card'; { TrendingUp, Award, CheckCircle2, Users, BarChart2 } from 'lucide-react'; { useState, useEffect } from 'react'. State: insights(obj), loading(bool). On mount fetch getCareerInsights(). Four stat cards: Total Certificates Issued (insights.totalCertificates), Active Certificates (insights.activeCertificates), Total Completions (insights.totalCompletions), Avg Skill Confidence (insights.avgSkillConfidence, show as %). Top 10 skill gaps: ranked list from insights.topSkillGaps array, each as a labeled bar. Privacy note at bottom: small text 'Only aggregated data shown — no individual student private data'. Loading: 4 Skeleton h-24 + Skeleton for gaps. Empty: EmptyState. Default export.

Create frontend/src/pages/CertificateVerification.jsx. Route: /certificate/verify/:certificateId. This is a STANDALONE page — NOT inside any dashboard wrapper. Imports: { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'; { api } from '../services/api'; { verifyCertificate } from '../services/careerService'; { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; { CheckCircle2, Clock, XCircle, Award, Search } from 'lucide-react'; { motion } from 'framer-motion'. State: certificate(obj|null), loading(bool), error(string|null), searchId(''), notFound(bool). On mount: get certificateId from useParams, call verifyCertificate(certificateId). Display: full-page centered layout (min-h-screen bg-theme-grid flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-6). NEO GEN branding: 'NEO GEN' text in saffron + 'Internship Engine' below it. Certificate card: neo-glass max-w-lg w-full p-8. Status visual: active→large CheckCircle2 emerald '✓ VERIFIED', pending→Clock amber '⏳ Pending Verification', revoked→XCircle red '✗ REVOKED'. Show: student first name + last initial only (e.g. 'Rahul S.'), organization, role, skills as tags, issued date (formatted), verification timestamp. CRITICAL: DO NOT show email, phone, or full last name. Not found state: friendly 'Certificate not found' message with search input. 'Verify Another' search input at bottom: text input for certificateId + Search button that navigates to /certificate/verify/{id}. Fully responsive. Default export.
acceptance_criteria: CertificateVerification does NOT import from any dashboard layout/wrapper.
Build passes after FEAT-004 wires everything.
verification: cd 'd:\my code\my project\NEO GEN INTERNSHIP ENGINE/frontend' && npm run build 2>&1 — run only after FEAT-004 completes.
findings: All 6 files created successfully. FeedbackForm.jsx: sub-component with 6 star-rating rows and 3 textareas, validates all ratings >= 1 before submit. CompletionWorkflow.jsx: fetches partner completions, handles status progression with confirm modal, integrates FeedbackForm in modal. CertificateWorkflow.jsx: lists completed internships in table, issues certificates via issueCertificate(), shows admin-verify note. CertificateManagement.jsx: admin table with status filter dropdown and search by certificateId, verify/revoke actions with modals. CareerIntelligenceInsights.jsx: 4 stat cards + top-10 skill gaps bar chart + privacy note. CertificateVerification.jsx: fully standalone page, no dashboard wrapper, shows first name + last initial only (never email/phone/full last name), search-another input at bottom. Build verification deferred to after FEAT-004 per spec.
